author: Amber Terry
text: My husband and I needed to get our septic tank pumped & Ohio Valley came to our house in a timely manner. The driver was super friendly and professional. Highly recommend.

author: Randella Robinson
text: We had a little bit of an emergency and Ohio Valley saved the day. They showed up on time, did a great job, and did it with a friendly, capable attitude. Highly recommend!

author: Holly Widener
text: Very helpful, very polite. Came out multiple times to get the job done correctly.

author: Sierra Curtis
text: Darin did a great job! Great guy to work with!

author: Angella Boehmann
text: Excellent service! Was able to come out the very next day to clean out our septic tank. I was unsure where the opening for the tank was since the previous owners of our home put 2 inches of dirt and grass over the cover but it was not a problem, Darin located it and dug it up for us! Super nice and professional, quick and left no mess. Definitely using them in the future!
